title: ToolNovation
description: The simple and handy mod that allows renovating a broken tool along with its enchantments.
body:
# _**ToolNovation**_

**Minecraft 1.21.1 | NeoForge**

---

**_ToolNovation_** changes how broken gear works in Minecraft. Your tools, weapons and armor **won't disappear** when they hit 0 durability - instead they enter a **broken** state and stay in your inventory until you repair them. This works with **all vanilla and modded gear** automatically, with no custom items to replace what you already use.

## Features

### Broken Gear Stays With You
When a tool, weapon, or piece of armor reaches 0 durability, it doesn't vanish. It becomes **broken** - unusable until repaired, but never lost. Broken armor still provides 25% of its protection (configurable).

### Repair Forge
A dedicated block for restoring broken and damaged gear. Place an item in it together with the matching repair material, and each material restores **25% durability** (up to 4 materials per repair by default - enough for a full restore). The required material is whatever the item normally repairs with, so it works for vanilla and modded gear alike.

By default, broken items can **only** be repaired at the Repair Forge - anvil and grindstone repair are blocked so the broken mechanic can't be bypassed. You can re-enable vanilla repair in the config if you prefer.

### Enchantments
Five enchantments, each with a real trade-off:

- **Eternal Binding** - preserves all enchantments through a repair. Without it, repairing a broken item strips its enchantments. The enchantment shatters when used, so plan ahead.
- **Vampire's Touch** - heals 20% of damage dealt, but doubles durability loss. Incompatible with Mending.
- **Featherweight** - +50% attack speed, but you take 30% more damage while wielding it.
- **Reinforced** - keeps working at 50% power when broken instead of locking up, at the cost of -15% mining speed while intact.
- **Tempered Edge** - +2 attack damage, but the item wears out twice as fast. Incompatible with Mending.

### Charm System
The same effects are also available as **charms** - an alternative way to apply Vampire's Touch, Featherweight, Reinforced and Tempered Edge, each with a clearly listed upside and downside.

### Quality of Life
- **Wear penalty** - worn-out tools (10% durability or less) mine slower, warning you before they break.
- **Break feedback** - an action-bar message and particles when an item finally breaks.
- **Advancements** - for breaking and repairing your first item.
- **In-game config** - a settings screen via Cloth Config (optional), with optional Modern UI support for a nicer-looking interface.

## Configuration
Repair % per material, max materials per repair, whether repairs keep enchantments, whether anvil/grindstone repair is blocked, broken-armor protection level, break messages, and the wear-penalty thresholds are all configurable.

## Installation

Drop the JAR into your `mods` folder. Requires:
- **NeoForge** 21+ for Minecraft 1.21.1

Optional:
- **Cloth Config** - adds the in-game settings screen
- **Modern UI** - improves the look of the interface
